items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, Clifford Jordan, Freddie Hubbard, myself, and the rhythm section, right.

ctx.x: That was [with] Clifford Jordan. Was that the tenor player?
Yes, Clifford Jordan, Freddie Hubbard, myself, and the rhythm section, right.
It was a very, very good band. I don’t remember if that was Tootie Heath on there on not. I can't remember for sure. [It was Tootie Heath on that recording.]
